## About
Lady Luck House of Queens Poker Club is a poker room on Fallbrook Dr in Houston. We keep the doors open every evening for people who want to play poker in good company.
Players have given us a 5 star rating across 38 Google reviews. A reviewer called us "up and coming," and another said they felt welcome on their first visit. If you're in the area, come by and see for yourself.

## Services
- Poker room: A poker room with friendly vibes and a good crowd.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours Monday through Thursday?
A: Monday through Thursday, and on Sunday, we're open from 5 PM to 2 AM.

Q: When do you open on Friday?
A: On Friday we open at 9 PM and stay open until 4 AM.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You'll find us at 6314 Fallbrook Dr Ste D, Houston, TX 77086.
